stemMd: A constant force acts perpendicular to an object's displacement throughout a motion segment. What work does this force do?

options.label: E
options.textMd: Force multiplied by displacement without an angle factor

explanationMd: Work is the scalar product of force and displacement, Fd cos θ. With θ=90 degrees, cosine is zero, so this force does no work during the segment.

distractorRationale.e: Work uses the component along displacement.
distractorRationale.b: A perpendicular force has no forward component.
distractorRationale.d: A perpendicular force has no opposing displacement component.
distractorRationale.a: Finite force and displacement do not imply infinity.
